CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_results_pkey ON public.game_results USING btree (id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_results_357_ante_uniq ON public.game_results USING btree (dealer_game_id, hand_number) WHERE ((game_type = ANY (ARRAY['3-5-7'::text, '3-5-7-game'::text, '357'::text])) AND (winning_hand_description = 'Ante'::text))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_results_holm_terminal_uniq ON public.game_results USING btree (dealer_game_id, hand_number) WHERE ((game_type = ANY (ARRAY['holm'::text, 'holm-game'::text])) AND (event_kind = ANY (ARRAY['pussy_tax_carryforward'::holm_event_kind, 'chucky_loss_pot_match'::holm_event_kind, 'chucky_tiebreak_pot_match'::holm_event_kind, 'showdown_final_award'::holm_event_kind, 'partial_tie_final_award'::holm_event_kind, 'chucky_final_award'::holm_event_kind])))
CREATE INDEX idx_game_results_dealer_game_id ON public.game_results USING btree (dealer_game_id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_results_357_sweep_uniq ON public.game_results USING btree (dealer_game_id, hand_number) WHERE ((game_type = ANY (ARRAY['3-5-7'::text, '3-5-7-game'::text, '357'::text])) AND (winning_hand_description = '3-5-7 Sweep'::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX gameplay_transfer_batches_pkey ON public.gameplay_transfer_batches USING btree (id)
